Acceptance limit: Persistent lock trips by ~245 RPM at <=30 RPM/s; no nuisance trip at 170 RPM; ramp rate and C2 value recorded (faster ramps are supply-power-bounded per the two-tier claim)

Method: Repeat calibration over 21.6 to 26.4 V and expected hot/cold board range
Acceptance limit: Rising trip remains above 190 RPM and at or below 220 RPM

Method: Run MPET and independently scope manual-spin line-to-line BEMF
Acceptance limit: Measured R L and BEMF recorded; EEPROM values replace 0xB1 0xAE 0xCA seeds

Method: 100 starts per direction from randomized rest at 30 35 and 40 RPM; repeat at 23.3 24.0 and 24.7 V
Acceptance limit: No retry reverse kick stall hunting or objectionable tonal sequence

Method: Run at 30 40 55 70 120 and 170 RPM
Acceptance limit: Stable speed and acceptable current waveform; each low speed released only if all starts pass

Method: Run motor-only and complete fan at 30 40 60 80 120 and 170 RPM; listen from bed
Acceptance limit: No identifiable motor controller bearing or structural tone at released sleep speed

Method: Run complete fan 8 hours at 170 RPM; measure RMS phase current with a current probe and record MCF q-axis estimate plus PWM peak separately
Acceptance limit: RMS phase current normally below 0.8 A and at most 1.0 A before investigation; 1.5 A limiter does not clip continuously; motor below 70 C; PCB below 85 C

Method: Restart while rotor coasts slowly in each direction
Acceptance limit: Clean handoff with no reverse kick stall or retry

Method: Inject maximum command and command-path fault
Acceptance limit: Independent tach confirms rotor never exceeds 180 RPM under active control

Method: Test lock overcurrent open phase FET thermal recovery buck reset undervoltage and every enabled MCF fault

Acceptance limit: Last locally held speed and direction continue

Method: Stop watchdog service reset ESP and hold GPIO states
Acceptance limit: Permission clears and DRVOFF rises; rotor coasts

Method: Command reverse at several running speeds
Acceptance limit: Ramp to zero verify stopped change DIR and restart

Method: Proof every installed printed adapter to 500 N radial
Acceptance limit: No crack slip permanent set pitch change hole elongation or fastener movement

Method: Condition representative adapters hot and humid under sustained load then apply one million combined centrifugal bending and torsion cycles
Acceptance limit: No cracking delamination pitch drift hole growth or set; subsequent 500 N proof passes

Method: Load one same-material same-orientation sample from every process batch radially to failure
Acceptance limit: Failure above 1.0 kN with documented mode

Acceptance limit: No damage loosening permanent deformation balance shift housing contact or catcher contact; restore and reverify 180 and 200 RPM limits before fixture removal

Method: Calculate final-mass drop energy then statically proof to 1.25 kN and dynamically release the final rotor into the catcher on a guarded off-ceiling fixture
Acceptance limit: Complete path including flush hub screws disk nut cotter spindle and plate retains mass with no opening or permanent set

Method: Measure hub OD blade tips masses first moments and assembled motion
Acceptance limit: Hub at most 0.10 mm TIR; tips within 0.5 mm; first moments within 0.5 percent; no objectionable vibration

Method: Add a documented conservative trial mass and run only behind barrier with manual abort at first unsafe motion
Acceptance limit: No fastener loosening plate motion housing or catcher contact; vibration response documented; no automatic shutdown is claimed

Method: Review hub blades adapters and fasteners at 270 RPM centrifugal load basis (raised from 250; supply-power bound)
Acceptance limit: Stress and retention calculations pass documented margins; do not dynamically test at this speed

Method: Document slab anchor model embedment spacing edge distance torque and plate seating
Acceptance limit: Matches reviewed anchor design; no ceiling-finish load path

Method: Calculate final-mass slack-drop energy then dynamically catch a representative final assembly on the exact cable fittings and carrier attachment off-ceiling; separately verify site anchor design
Acceptance limit: Independent path; 15 to 20 mm slack; complete rating at least 4.5 kN; no fitting opening or permanent set

Method: Run increasing limited speeds while observing plate tether capture Hall gap wall gap and resonance
Acceptance limit: No movement contact new resonance or clearance loss

Method: With the motor running on the bench, interrupt the +12V_TACH rail (lift the 47 ohm feed or force TPS7A16 EN low)
Acceptance limit: TACH_PGOOD_N clears the persistent lock; DRVOFF rises; lock survives until a genuine power cycle

Method: Cold power-up at nominal and slow-ramp 24 V input; repeat 20 times; probe U6 /PRE and /CLR release order
Acceptance limit: U6 presets healthy on every boot (delayed /PRE releases after TACH_PGOOD_N); the fan can arm after safe boot

Method: Individually verify each BAT54H diode path into U5 /CLR (lift/measure); force DRVOFF low at the 2N7002K drain and document the result
Acceptance limit: Every fault source independently clears permission; forced-DRVOFF-low behavior recorded as the documented residual risk

Method: Disconnect the Hall cable (and separately remove the magnet) while running at 60 RPM
Acceptance limit: Supervisory FG-vs-Hall plausibility stops the fan within ~5 revolutions; event surfaced as a fault

Method: Guarded motor-only bench run with marker installed, 190-240 RPM (requires the written two-person temporary-limit-bypass procedure per MEC-03; U6 will latch each run); record Hall pulse width vs speed
Acceptance limit: Trip fires from the real magnet path (not injected waveform); measured pulse width has margin against the LM2907 charge-pump slew

Method: Hard-loop the Matter/network task on the bench while the fan runs
Acceptance limit: Fan continues at last speed; control task and heartbeat unaffected; recovery on task restart

Method: Open the physical cutoff at 170 RPM with final cable; scope VM and phase behavior through coast
Acceptance limit: Clean coast; no drive/UV chatter from windmill back-feed; firmware treats the UV report as stop + revoke

Method: Arm and command a start with the rotor mechanically blocked (or the permission latch held cleared)
Acceptance limit: No FG edge within 15 s faults to NoRotation; permission revoked; no further drive command until a fresh user command

Method: Command a start while the rotor is windmilling from a hand spin
Acceptance limit: No arm pulse until both FG and Hall are quiet for 5 s; start proceeds after; a rotor still turning at 120 s reports NeverStopped

Method: Assert the MCF ALARM pin (or provoke an OTW report) while running
Acceptance limit: Fan stops speed zero and permission revoked; state stays Fault until a fresh user command

Acceptance limit: SafeBoot does not reach IdleOff; state Fault with config_mismatch naming the register; permission never armed

Method: Capture a telemetry CSV from a device with a verified image and one without
Acceptance limit: Every row carries config=verified or config=unverified accordingly; an unverified capture is identifiable without external notes

Method: With a golden image committed, `reg write` any register in 0x080-0x0AE while stopped
